author: smcarus
title: Will Argentina's government debt ratio fall in 2026?
summary: Give the probability that IMF WEO general government gross debt for Argentina, in % of GDP, is lower for 2026 than for 2025, both as first read on or after 1 May 2027 (after the April 2027 WEO).
knownLimits: The 2026 figure in the April 2027 WEO is still an IMF estimate and may be revised later; the first reading stands.
A large peso move changes the ratio through foreign-currency debt as much as through the budget.
